title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether the Basic Pension Insurance Pooled Funds of Retired Employees of Enterprises Shall Be Included in the Bankruptcy Property Distribution Plan

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2002] No. 12
Higher People's Court of Yunnan Province:
We have received your Request, Yun Gao Fa [2001] No. 45, titled "Request for Instructions on Whether the Old-Age Pooling Funds of Retired Personnel of Enterprises May Be Included in the Distribution of Bankruptcy Property". Upon deliberation, our reply is as follows:
The old-age insurance pooling funds of retired personnel of bankrupt enterprises constitute the "labor insurance expenses" as stipulated in Article 37, Paragraph 2 of the Bankruptcy Law (Trial Implementation) of the People's Republic of China and Article 204 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and shall be classified into the first order of distribution of bankruptcy property.
This is our reply.
April 18, 2002
